items.Sentence: All off-site waste ... is prescreened for solid and inert material (i.e., rags, rocks, grit, etc.) using automatic equipment or a manually racked bar screen.
discharged into one of two aerobic digesters via an automatically controlled wet well utilizing a lead and lag pump system.
Each digester is a complete mix system that is kept in a homogenous state by an aeration diffuser system utilizing blowers.
Digested sludge from each aerobic digester is pumped to one of two centrifuges for solids processing.
Effluent is stored in two two-million- gallon above ground storage tanks.

Disinfection is achieved by dosing the effluent stored in the effluent storage tanks or dosing as effluent is applied to the spray-fields through chlorine contact chambers with sodium hypochlorite or other approved disinfectant.
...as effluent is applied to the spray-fields through chlorine contact chambers...
The processed solids from each centrifuge are deposited into temporary storage bins that are transported to the on-site Class II landfill for disposal.
The processed solids from each centrifuge are ... transported off-site to a permitted facility.
